text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No! No! No! It's not fair! I always<n>brush carefully
every day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several hours earlier...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?! My... My teeth hurt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly take a look inside Shinko<n>Windy's mouth.
However, she<n>doesn't appear to have any cavities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I'd expect no less—Shinko<n>Windy is
rather proud of her teeth,<n>and makes sure to brush
them<n>thoroughly each and every day.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All I did was nibble on some ice<n>cream... What's
going on with my<n>precious teeth?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I immediately take her to a dentist,where we learn that her teeth havebecome hypersensitive as a result ofbrushing for too long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They'll naturally go back to normal<n>eventually, but
just in case, I try to<n>convince Shinko Windy to cut
down<n>on her brushing time.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No can do! What'll happen if I get<n>cavities?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems strongly attached to the<n>preconception
that brushing for longer<n>will protect against cavities.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, I'd say you're in<n>a bit of a
bind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You can leave this to me! I have a<n>secret plan that
will solve everything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from her confidence, she<n>must have
something pretty<n>impressive up her sleeves...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Windy. Look at this ultradelicious ice cream I have!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nom, nom. Ahh, so tasty.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'd really like you to try some, too...<n>but it'd
probably hurt your teeth,<n>right? Oh, what a shame.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If only you cut down on your brushing<n>time... then
you could've joined me<n>and had a bite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her plan is exceedingly... ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I don't care! I'd rather go<n>without ice cream
than get cavities!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I failed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, please wait! I'd like anotherchance to redeem myself! I have asecond secret plan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll make her understand how scary
hypersensitivity is!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If I explain how it can lead to tooth<n>decay and gum
disease, then I'm<n>sure she'll change her mind!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And if that doesn't work, look at<n>these! Demonic
mutation stickers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Some look like thorns and others like<n>scars, so I'm
sure she'd enjoy<n>playing around with them!
Maybe I<n>can offer them as a reward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Basically, she's thinking of either<n>explaining things
to Shinko Windy as<n>simply as possible, or trying to
bribe<n>her with a reward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Once again, such ordinary plans<n>hardly seem
worth keeping secret,<n>but it couldn't hurt to try them
out.
choice_data_list: Let's motivate her by explaining things simply.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We search for Shinko Windy, who<n>had run off, and
eventually find her<n>hiding behind the academy
building.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay! Just follow my lead and play<n>along!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahem. Gee, hypersensitivity sure<n>sounds awful.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, the smallest touch starts<n>to hurt, and
you can't even enjoy<n>brushing your teeth
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's also a strong chance you<n>end up with
something worse, like<n>painful cavities.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...C-cavities?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello there, Windy. Is something<n>wrong?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...I'll stop brushing my teeth so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the days that follow, Shinko Windy<n>starts
brushing her teeth with a<n>stopwatch in hand, and
her<n>hypersensitivity goes away very<n>quickly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to search for Shinko<n>Windy and offer her
stickers as a<n>reward. Eventually, we find her hiding
under a staircase.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr! No means no!
choice_data_list: Take a look at these, Windy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I show her the stickers that<n>Matikanetannhauser
told me about.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-why are these stickers so<n>awesome?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They've got fangs, spikes, wings,<n>even horns!
They all look extra<n>diabolical!
choice_data_list:
They're yours if you cut down on your brushing
time.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's a real dirty move!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her initial protest, Shinko<n>Windy seems
swayed by the offer,<n>and she changes her brushing
habits.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grawr! I'm a demon! Look how<n>awesome and
scary I am!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eek! Where did this horrifying<n>monster come from?!
Someone save<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the days that follow, Shinko<n>Windy's
hypersensitivity completely<n>heals, and I spot her
wreaking havoc<n>while covered in stickers.
